author: Haroen Viaene
subject: fix(history): cleanUrlOnDispose also prevents write after dispose (#6305)
bodyLines: In real situations, it seems like #5966 forgot to account for `write` being called through `onInternalStateChange`, which is deferred and thus called after the dispose of the middleware/router.
This PR solves that situation by ensuring the router never writes after dispose if this option is set to `false`.
